{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of age by sex
print('Age distribution by sex:')
print(trial_df.groupby('sex')['age'].describe())

# Check the distribution of biomarker_baseline by sex
print('\nBiomarker baseline distribution by sex:')
print(trial_df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].describe())

# Check if there are any confounding variables that differ by sex
print('\nBiomarker baseline by sex (mean):')
print(trial_df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].mean())

# Check for imbalance in other variables
print('\nDistribution of sample_seq by sex:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['sample_seq']))"}
